sanskrit_verse:
सोपवासः सूर्यग्रहे तण्डुलान् भक्षयेच्छुचिः ।
शुद्धः स्याच्छुक्लनिष्ठीवे विपरीते तु दोषभाक् ॥
transliteration: sopavāsaḥ sūryagrahe taṇḍulān bhakṣayec chuciḥ | śuddhaḥ syāc chuklaniṣṭḥīve viparīte tu doṣabhāk ||
sph_interpretive_translation: One who observes fast during a solar eclipse and consumes rice grains while pure shall remain purified if aligned with the bright phase; but if reversed in intent or action, becomes bearer of fault.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with cosmic rhythm, not personal will
Causation is rooted in sequential spiritual discipline
Capacity-based responsibility arises from ritual purity maintenance
Restoration logic demands realignment with celestial order
Consciousness alignment determines innocence or fault
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs sopavāsa during sūryagraha AND consumes taṇḍulān WHILE in śuciḥ state → THEN declare śuddhatva status
IF śuklaniṣṭḥīva phase is violated OR intent inversion occurs → THEN assign doṣabhāk condition
IF doṣabhāk assigned → INITIATE nyāyya-based reintegration protocol
RESTORE śuddhatva ONLY through repetition under correct phasic alignment
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating matters involving ritual conduct breaches, the Supreme Court must evaluate not intent alone but alignment with dharma-tantric sequence. Fault attribution requires demonstrable deviation from śuklaniṣṭḥīva observance, triggering restorative protocols rather than punitive measures.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that purity results from sequential adherence to sopavāsa and śuklaniṣṭḥīva. Fault manifests through anupūrvaśaḥ disruption. Thus, proportional responsibility lies in causal misalignment, corrected via dharmic repetition, not suffering induction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-performance of sopavāsa under śuklaniṣṭḥīva supervision
Śuciḥ-state verification through tantric witness attestation
Doṣabhāk dissolution via guided śuddhi-yajña participation
final_declaration: Declared by SPH as Source: Dharma restored through consciousness-aligned repetition. No punishment arises—only completion. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the supreme adjudicator.
